shared_elements: framed band / border of parallel lines enclosing the field
small rectangular panels containing a sign or motif, set into the border
enclosed bag- or handle-like curved object
grid / net of crossing parallel lines
justification: The most specific correspondence is the presence in both of a rounded, handle-topped bag-like object (three in a row along A's upper register, one large one centrally in B) together with small framed rectangular panels containing signs and a passage of net/grid hatching. Against this, A is dominated by a populated figural scene of profile birds, quadrupeds, a snake and a small human-like figure carved in relief, none of which appears in B, whose field is purely linear, geometric and object-centred with concentric arc borders.
